metrics.profile_summary: Operations and client management professional with a BBA and expertise in supply chain and international e-commerce support. Skilled in inventory control, GRN processing, and cross-functional coordination to enhance service quality and client satisfaction.

Resolved pharmaceutical campaign queries and managed work orders and case tracking using internal ERP systems.
Managed client accounts and lead generation for Durable Medical Equipment campaigns, consistently meeting performance and service targets.
